_what_is: Buying signals: why this company might need what you sell. scan.py looks for each signal on the company's own pages and keeps the page and the sentence that prove it. Each signal: id (one or two letters, used in the offer ladder and the CSV), label, points, and one detector. Detectors: 'terms' (plain substrings searched in the body sentences of the pages), 'phrases' (stronger phrases searched in the whole page text), 'page_types' (only look on these pages: home, contact, about, team, services, jobs, alt_language, documents), 'kind': 'pdf_links' (count linked PDFs, 'exclude_patterns' removes the ones that already look localized), 'kind': 'sector_keywords' (the sector's own keywords from sectors.json), 'requires' (signal ids that must have matched), 'needs_absent': 'alt_version' (only when the site has no version in your target language). Points add up in score.py.
